article: Paint.NET features, uses, and download options
scope: Read and compared the complete Japanese article and all twelve translations; checked Paint.NET features and formats, the current Microsoft Paint layers/transparency comparison, free classic vs paid Store distribution and update behavior, live system requirements, installation-page imagery, metadata, and all official references.
findings: Replaced the stale claim that Microsoft Paint lacks layers/transparency; Windows Paint now supports both, so the comparison highlights more specific Paint.NET tools.
Updated the free vs paid Microsoft Store information and removed the obsolete 2022 red-box download screenshot; directs readers to the current official download table.
Added current official Windows/CPU/GPU/storage requirements and qualified performance claims.
Removed the obsolete Paint.NET 4.3.12 screenshot and unrelated internal links; preserved the original publication date (2022-09-14) and set lastmod (2026-11-25).
